title: Vegan Peanut Butter Cup Milkshake (Creamy & Rich!)
summary: Healthy plant-based milkshakes just got a whole lot better with this vegan peanut butter cup milkshake. I blend frozen bananas, creamy peanut butter, and rich cacao into a thick chocolatey drink that …
ingredients: ¾ cup almond or cashew milk (or use ¾ cup full fat coconut milk for optimal creaminess)
5-6 ice cubes (optional for an icier shake)
1 tablespoon maple syrup or 4 dates (optional for extra sweetness)
steps: Place all ingredients into a food processor, blender or high speed blender and mix until well blended. Add more milk if too thick and blend again.
author: Anjali Shah
